items.summary:
ProTechnology Innovation Showcase: From the surface of the sun to the depths of the ocean" – Use Cases in the Display and Communication of Complex NOAA Scientific Data 

November 23, 2026 

A very successful ProTechnology Innovation Showcase was held on November 18, 2026, featuring “Use Cases in the Display and Communication of Complex NOAA Scientific Data”. We had over 200 attendees and featured presentations from six different ProTech Prime vendors and their teams. Please find a copy of their presentations here offsite link . 

We plan to hold future ProTechnology Innovation Showcases regularly, covering a variety of topics. For the latest updates, please visit our news and events page: news and events page . 

We value your input! If you have suggestions for a topic for our next event or wish to provide feedback on this gathering, please share your thoughts by completing this Google form: Link to Feedback Form offsite link .

Thank you for your participation. We look forward to seeing you at the next ProTechnology Innovation Showcase.
